scenes.visual: Dark terminal screen, red error text scrolling. Number 120 pulses in center, shatters into green checkmarks.
scenes.voiceover: One hundred and twenty crashes. Every twenty-three minutes. This was Echo System — until it fixed itself.

scenes.visual: Code editor view. Single line highlighted: summary = data.setdefault. Arrow points to type mismatch. Error text overlay.
scenes.voiceover: A string where a dictionary was expected. The simplest kind of bug — until it becomes a crash loop that never stops.

scenes.visual: Split screen: Sentinel scanning (red to amber), Healer applying patch (amber to green). Log lines stream I-AUTO-003 FIXED.
scenes.voiceover: Sentinel detected the pattern. Healer traced the root cause. A one-line fix — type coercion — and the loop was broken.

scenes.visual: Dashboard view. Services turning green sequentially. Health score counter ticks from 20 toward 75.
scenes.voiceover: Gateway stable. Autoloop breathing. Public endpoints healthy. But the system knows the story isn't over.

scenes.visual: Agent network visualization. Three amber nodes (memory, watchdog, timeouts), rest pulsing green.
scenes.voiceover: Autonomous systems don't eliminate failure — they learn to recover from it faster. The real test is what happens next.

scenes.visual: Dark background. Typography: Building systems that remember, repair, and endure. TAHS Knowledge Engine footer.
scenes.voiceover: Building systems that remember, repair, and endure. Because history deserves better than fragility.
